finalText:
Build now exits 0 cleanly (retries 3, 0 errors).

The real bug: `src/core/settings.js:17` referenced a bare `retries` variable that was never defined anywhere — a `ReferenceError` thrown at the link stage, buried under ~900 lines of harmless compile/dedupe noise and 3 pre-existing warnings. Fixed by adding `retries: 3` to the `DEFAULTS` object and using `env.retries || DEFAULTS.retries` for `maxRetries`, matching what the adjacent comment already described as the intended behavior. The 3 warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, unused export, circular import) are separate cosmetic issues, not the failure — left them alone since you asked specifically to get the build passing.
